name: MFA State
summary: Describes MFA enrollment, challenge, and recent step-up strength.

values.name: Enrolled
values.summary: At least one MFA factor is enrolled but no current step-up exists.

values.name: Challenge Required
values.summary: A stronger proof is required for the requested action.

values.name: Challenge Active
values.summary: An MFA or step-up challenge is in progress.

values.name: Satisfied
values.summary: MFA or step-up proof is currently fresh enough for its intended capability.

values.name: Expired
values.summary: Previous step-up proof is no longer fresh.
